## File: sgl-project_sglang/python/sglang/srt/mem_cache/cpp_radix_tree/radix_tree.py

Prompts

```
['create a RadixTreeCpp instance with disabled flag, host size, page size, and write-through threshold', 'test the match_prefix method to find matching prefix indices on GPU and CPU', 'run evict to remove a number of tokens from the radix tree and return evicted indices', 'refactor writing_through to insert key-value pairs and perform write-through to CPU', 'review the lock_ref method to lock or unlock tree nodes and prevent eviction']
```

Usage

```
{'create_RadixTreeCpp': 'create a RadixTreeCpp instance with disabled flag, host size, page size, and write-through threshold', 'test_match_prefix': 'test the match_prefix method to find matching prefix indices on GPU and CPU', 'run_evict': 'run evict to remove a number of tokens from the radix tree and return evicted indices', 'refactor_writing_through': 'refactor writing_through to insert key-value pairs and perform write-through to CPU', 'review_lock_ref': 'review the lock_ref method to lock or unlock tree nodes and prevent eviction'}
```
